jobs.description:
Ready to move beyond “keep-the-lights-on” and shape the future of a global bank’s digital workplace?
At Vontobel, we’re transforming our core collaboration platforms from on-prem Atlassian to Confluence Cloud, while evolving SharePoint into a powerful, modern intranet experience used by every employee, every day.
As a Senior Web / Software Developer, you won’t just support systems; you’ll redefine them. Take ownership, drive innovation, and build solutions that truly matter across the organization.
If you’re hands-on, forward-thinking, and excited to make a visible impact, this is your chance to lead from the front.

What would your role be?

• Own and deliver the technical implementation of intranet and collaboration use cases across Microsoft SharePoint and Atlassian Confluence, from requirements to production operations.

• Play a leading engineering role in the migration from on‑prem Atlassian Data Center to Confluence Cloud (Enterprise) and related platform evolution.

• Design, build, and maintain modern SharePoint Online solutions (sites, information architecture, permissions, content models, search, and governance) with a strong focus on developer-grade extensibility.

• Build and evolve intranet features and integrations (e.g., navigation, publishing patterns, content rollups, automation, and platform-wide components) that scale to a firm-wide audience.

• Develop and maintain integrations and migration tooling between Confluence and SharePoint (content move, metadata mapping, link integrity, redirects, and quality checks) to enable a controlled, low-risk transition.

• Act as a senior hands-on engineer: lead code reviews, establish engineering standards, improve CI/CD and operational readiness, and mentor colleagues working on the intranet and platform ecosystem.

What are we looking for?

• Bachelor’s degree in computer science, a related field, or a completed software engineering apprenticeship.

• At least 5 years of hands-on professional experience as senior web / software engineer with strong delivery track record in enterprise platforms and high-visibility web systems such as intranets.

• Deep, current expertise in Microsoft SharePoint (development and administration) including modern SharePoint patterns and operating models in a regulated environment.

• Strong experience building web solutions (TypeScript/JavaScript, modern frontend, APIs) and implementing secure, maintainable backend services where needed.

• Practical know-how with Atlassian ecosystems (Confluence/Jira) and the ability to engineer solutions across both on‑prem and cloud setups.

• Solid understanding of identity, permissions, and governance concepts, comfortable designing and operating access models for bank-wide information platforms.

• Experience with migrations (platform or content), including planning, tooling, validation, stakeholder communication, and incremental rollout strategies.

• A pragmatic, communicative team player who can own decisions, handle ambiguity, and collaborate closely with business stakeholders, security, and IT operations.

• Fluent in English; German is a strong plus.

What do we offer?

• Top Zurich location with collaboration spaces and free lunch

• All the latest technology to help you excel and advance

• Agile environment in how we think, the way we work and our trust for each other

• Lots of special perks, including home office possibility up to 20%

• Flat hierarchy with collaboration at all levels

• Campus feeling and a collaborative spirit

We are looking for talented people, not just a CV that ticks all the boxes. Even if you do not have absolutely everything we have asked for, if this role sounds like a good fit for you, we encourage you to apply.

Why Vontobel?
At Vontobel, you are building better futures for our clients and society, as well as for yourself. As a family-owned and publicly listed company with over 2,000 professionals based in 28 locations globally and headquartered in Zurich, we’r

descriptionByLocale.it:
Pronti a passare oltre “keep-the-lights-on” e plasmare il futuro del posto di lavoro digitale di una banca globale? A Vontobel, stiamo trasformando le nostre piattaforme di collaborazione core da Atlassian a Confluence Cloud, evolvendo SharePoint in una potente e moderna esperienza intranet utilizzata da ogni dipendente, ogni giorno. Come sviluppatore di Web / software senior, non solo supporterai i sistemi; li ridefinirai. Prendere la proprietà, guidare l'innovazione e costruire soluzioni che veramente importano in tutta l'organizzazione. Se siete hands-on, in avanti-thinking, e entusiasta di fare un impatto visibile, questa è la vostra possibilità di portare dalla parte anteriore. Qual è il tuo ruolo?
• Possedere e fornire l'implementazione tecnica dei casi di uso intranet e collaborazione in Microsoft SharePoint e Atlassian Confluence, dai requisiti alle operazioni di produzione.
• Gioca un ruolo di ingegneria leader nella migrazione da atlantesian Data Center on-prem a Confluence Cloud (Enterprise) e relativa evoluzione della piattaforma.
• Progettare, costruire e mantenere moderne soluzioni SharePoint Online (siti, architettura delle informazioni, autorizzazioni, modelli di contenuti, ricerca e governance) con un forte focus sull'estensibilità dello sviluppatore.
• Costruire ed evolvere le funzionalità e le integrazioni intranet (ad esempio, la navigazione, i modelli editoriali, i roll-up dei contenuti, l'automazione e i componenti a livello di piattaforma) che scalano a un pubblico di dimensioni compatte.
• Sviluppare e mantenere integrazioni e strumenti di migrazione tra Confluence e SharePoint (lo spostamento dei contenuti, mappatura dei metadati, integrità dei link, reindirizzamenti e controlli di qualità) per consentire una transizione controllata e a basso rischio.
• Agire come ingegnere mani-on senior: le revisioni del codice di piombo, stabilire gli standard di ingegneria, migliorare CI/CD e la prontezza operativa, e i colleghi di mentore che lavorano sull'ecosistema intranet e piattaforma. Cosa stiamo cercando?
• Corso di laurea in informatica, un campo correlato, o un apprendistato di ingegneria del software completato.
• Almeno 5 anni di esperienza professionale pratica come ingegnere web / software senior con forte record di traccia di consegna in piattaforme aziendali e sistemi web ad alta visibilità come Intranets.
• Profonda e attuale esperienza in Microsoft SharePoint (sviluppo e amministrazione) tra cui moderni modelli SharePoint e modelli operativi in un ambiente regolamentato.
• Forte esperienza costruzione di soluzioni web (TypeScript/JavaScript, frontend moderno, API) e l'implementazione di servizi backend sicuri e manutenbili dove necessario.
• Il know-how pratico con gli ecosistemi atlanti (Confluenza/Jira) e la capacità di progettare soluzioni sia in configurazione on-prem che cloud.
• Solida comprensione dei concetti di identità, autorizzazioni e governance, modelli di progettazione e accesso operativo comodi per piattaforme di informazione su scala bancaria.
• Esperienza con le migrazioni (piattaforma o contenuto), tra cui pianificazione, tooling, validazione, comunicazione degli stakeholder e strategie di rollout incrementale.
• Un giocatore di squadra pragmatico e comunicativo che può possedere decisioni, gestire l'ambiguità e collaborare strettamente con gli stakeholder aziendali, la sicurezza e le operazioni IT.
• Fluente in inglese; il tedesco è un vantaggio forte. Cosa offriamo?
• Top Zurigo location con spazi di collaborazione e pranzo gratuito
• Tutte le ultime tecnologie per aiutarti ad eccellere e anticipare
• Ambiente aggressivo in come pensiamo, il modo in cui lavoriamo e la nostra fiducia l'uno per l'altro
• Un sacco di vantaggi speciali, tra cui possibilità ufficio domestico fino al 20%
• Gerarchia piatta con collaborazione a tutti i livelli
• Il sentimento del campus e lo spirito collaborativo Stiamo cercando persone di talento, non solo un CV che ticchetta tutte le scatole. Anche se non avete assolutamente tutto quello che abbiamo chiesto, se questo ruolo suona come una buona misura per voi, vi incoraggiamo ad applicare. Perché Vontobel? A Vontobel, stai costruendo un futuro migliore per i nostri clienti e la società, così come per te. Come azienda di proprietà familiare e quotata in pubblico con oltre 2.000 professionisti con sede in 28 sedi a livello globale e con sede a Zurigo, siamo

descriptionByLocale.de:
Sind Sie bereit, über "Keep-the-Lights-on" hinauszugehen und die Zukunft des digitalen Arbeitsplatzes einer globalen Bank zu gestalten? Bei Vontobel transformieren wir unsere zentralen Collaboration-Plattformen von On-Prem Atlassian zu Confluence Cloud, während wir SharePoint zu einer leistungsstarken, modernen Intranet-Erfahrung entwickeln, die täglich von jedem Mitarbeiter genutzt wird. Als Senior Web / Software Developer unterstützen Sie nicht nur Systeme; Sie werden sie neu definieren. Übernehmen Sie Verantwortung, treiben Sie Innovationen voran und entwickeln Sie Lösungen, die im gesamten Unternehmen wirklich wichtig sind. Wenn Sie praktisch, vorausschauend und aufgeregt sind, um eine sichtbare Wirkung zu erzielen, ist dies Ihre Chance, von vorne zu führen. Was wäre Ihre Rolle?
• Eigenverantwortung und Bereitstellung der technischen Implementierung von Intranet- und Collaboration-Anwendungsfällen in Microsoft SharePoint und Atlassian Confluence, von den Anforderungen bis zum Produktionsbetrieb.
• Spielen Sie eine führende technische Rolle bei der Migration von On-Prem Atlassian Data Center zu Confluence Cloud (Enterprise) und der damit verbundenen Plattformentwicklung.
• Entwerfen, erstellen und pflegen Sie moderne SharePoint Online-Lösungen (Websites, Informationsarchitektur, Berechtigungen, Inhaltsmodelle, Suche und Governance) mit einem starken Fokus auf Erweiterbarkeit auf Entwicklerebene.
• Erstellen und Entwickeln von Intranet-Funktionen und -Integrationen (z. B. Navigation, Veröffentlichungsmuster, Inhaltsrollups, Automatisierung und plattformweite Komponenten), die für ein unternehmensweites Publikum skaliert werden.
• Entwicklung und Pflege von Integrationen und Migrationstools zwischen Confluence und SharePoint (Content Move, Metadaten-Mapping, Link-Integrität, Redirects und Qualitätsüberprüfungen), um einen kontrollierten Übergang mit geringem Risiko zu ermöglichen.
• Handeln Sie als Senior Hands-on Engineer: Führen Sie Code Reviews, legen Sie Engineering-Standards fest, verbessern Sie CI / CD und Betriebsbereitschaft und betreuen Sie Kollegen, die am Intranet- und Plattform-Ökosystem arbeiten. Worauf warten wir?
• Bachelor-Abschluss in Informatik, einem verwandten Bereich oder einer abgeschlossenen Software-Engineering-Lehre.
• Mindestens 5 Jahre praktische Berufserfahrung als Senior Web / Software Engineer mit einer starken Lieferbilanz in Unternehmensplattformen und hoch sichtbaren Websystemen wie Intranets.
• Tiefe, aktuelle Expertise in Microsoft SharePoint (Entwicklung und Verwaltung) einschließlich moderner SharePoint-Muster und Betriebsmodelle in einer regulierten Umgebung.
• Starke Erfahrung beim Erstellen von Weblösungen (TypeScript/JavaScript, modernes Frontend, APIs) und bei Bedarf bei der Implementierung sicherer, wartbarer Backend-Services.
• Praktisches Know-how mit Atlassian-Ökosystemen (Confluence/Jira) und die Fähigkeit, Lösungen für On-Prem- und Cloud-Setups zu entwickeln.
• Solides Verständnis von Identität, Berechtigungen und Governance-Konzepten, komfortables Entwerfen und Betreiben von Zugriffsmodellen für bankweite Informationsplattformen.
• Erfahrung mit Migrationen (Plattform oder Inhalt), einschließlich Planung, Tooling, Validierung, Stakeholder-Kommunikation und inkrementellen Rollout-Strategien.
• Ein pragmatischer, kommunikativer Teamplayer, der eigene Entscheidungen treffen, mit Mehrdeutigkeiten umgehen und eng mit Stakeholdern aus Wirtschaft, Sicherheit und IT zusammenarbeiten kann.
• Fließend Englisch; Deutsch ist ein starkes Plus. Was bieten wir an?
• Top Zürich Lage mit Collaboration Spaces und kostenlosem Mittagessen
• Die neueste Technologie, die Ihnen hilft, sich auszuzeichnen und weiterzuentwickeln
• Agile Umgebung, wie wir denken, wie wir arbeiten und unser Vertrauen füreinander
• Viele besondere Vergünstigungen, einschließlich Home Office Möglichkeit bis zu 20%
• Flache Hierarchie mit Zusammenarbeit auf allen Ebenen
• Campus Feeling und ein kooperativer Geist Wir suchen talentierte Leute, nicht nur einen Lebenslauf, der alle Kästchen ankreuzt. Auch wenn Sie nicht absolut alles haben, wonach wir gefragt haben, wenn diese Rolle nach einer guten Passform für Sie klingt, empfehlen wir Ihnen, sich zu bewerben. Warum Vontobel? Bei Vontobel bauen Sie eine bessere Zukunft für unsere Kunden und die Gesellschaft sowie für sich selbst. descriptionByLocale.fr:
Prêt à aller au-delà de l'entretien des lumières et à façonner l'avenir d'une banque mondiale. Chez Vontobel, nous transformons nos plates-formes de collaboration de l'Atlas sur site à Confluence Cloud, tout en évoluant SharePoint en une expérience intranet puissante et moderne utilisée par chaque employé, chaque jour. En tant que Senior Web / Software Developer, vous n'avez gagné que des systèmes de soutien ; vous allez les redéfinir. S'approprier, stimuler l'innovation et construire des solutions qui comptent vraiment pour l'ensemble de l'organisation. Si vous êtes mains-sur, avant-pensant, et excité de faire un impact visible, c'est votre chance de mener de l'avant. Quel serait votre rôle ?
• Propre et fournir la mise en œuvre technique d'intranet et de cas d'utilisation de collaboration dans Microsoft SharePoint et Atlassian Confluence, des exigences aux opérations de production.
• Jouer un rôle d'ingénierie de premier plan dans la migration du Data Center atlasien à Confluence Cloud (Entreprise) et l'évolution de plate-forme connexe.
• Concevoir, construire et maintenir des solutions modernes SharePoint Online (sites, architecture de l'information, autorisations, modèles de contenu, recherche et gouvernance) avec un accent fort sur l'extensibilité de niveau développeur.
• Construisez et développez des fonctionnalités et des intégrations intranet (p. ex. navigation, modèles de publication, déploiements de contenu, automatisation et composants à l'échelle de la plate-forme) qui s'étendent à un public à l'échelle de l'entreprise.
• Développer et maintenir les intégrations et les outils de migration entre Confluence et SharePoint (déplacement du contenu, cartographie des métadonnées, intégrité des liens, redirections et contrôles de qualité) pour permettre une transition contrôlée à faible risque.
• Agir en tant qu'ingénieur principal : examiner le code de conduite, établir des normes d'ingénierie, améliorer l'IC/CD et la préparation opérationnelle, et mentorer les collègues travaillant sur l'écosystème intranet et plate-forme. Qu'est-ce qu'on cherche ?
• Baccalauréat en informatique, domaine connexe ou apprentissage en génie logiciel.
• Au moins 5 ans d'expérience professionnelle pratique en tant qu'ingénieur web/logiciel senior avec un solide bilan de livraison dans les plates-formes d'entreprise et les systèmes web haute visibilité tels que les intranets.
• Expertise profonde et actuelle de Microsoft SharePoint (développement et administration), y compris les modèles modernes de SharePoint et les modèles d'exploitation dans un environnement réglementé.
• Forte expérience de construction de solutions web (TypeScript/JavaScript, frontend moderne, API) et la mise en œuvre de services de backend sécurisés et durables, le cas échéant.
• Savoir-faire pratique avec les écosystèmes atlasiens (Confluence/Jira) et la capacité d'élaborer des solutions à la fois sur site et dans les nuages.
• Compréhension solide de l'identité, des permissions et des concepts de gouvernance, conception confortable et exploitation de modèles d'accès pour les plateformes d'information à l'échelle de la banque.
• Expérience des migrations (plateforme ou contenu), y compris la planification, l'outillage, la validation, la communication avec les intervenants et les stratégies de déploiement progressif.
• Un joueur d'équipe pragmatique et communicatif qui peut prendre des décisions, gérer l'ambiguïté et collaborer étroitement avec les intervenants commerciaux, la sécurité et les opérations informatiques.
• Fluent en anglais; l'allemand est un plus fort. Qu'est-ce qu'on offre ?
• Meilleur emplacement de Zurich avec des espaces de collaboration et déjeuner gratuit
• Toutes les dernières technologies pour vous aider à exceller et à progresser
• Environnement agile dans notre façon de penser, notre façon de travailler et notre confiance l'un pour l'autre
• Beaucoup de avantages spéciaux, y compris la possibilité de bureau à domicile jusqu'à 20%
• Hiérarchie plate avec collaboration à tous les niveaux
• Sensation de campus et esprit de collaboration Nous cherchons des gens talentueux, pas seulement un CV qui coche toutes les boîtes. Même si vous n'avez pas absolument tout ce que nous avons demandé, si ce rôle vous semble bon, nous vous encourageons à postuler. Pourquoi Vontobel ? Chez Vontobel, vous construisez de meilleurs avenirs pour nos clients et notre société, ainsi que pour vous-même. jobs.title: Head of Fixed Income Sales
jobs.description:
Are you ready to take on a leadership role and shape the future of a high-performing Fixed Income Sales and Capital Markets franchise?

We are looking for a new Head of Fixed Income Sales to succeed the current leadership and further develop our established institutional client and capital markets business.

As Head of Fixed Income Sales, you will lead the franchise, combining active client engagement with strategic leadership and commercial accountability.

What would your role be?

• Lead and manage the Fixed Income Sales team (5 FTEs), fostering a high-performance culture, mentoring talent, and ensuring strong collaboration across functions.

• Own the P&L of the Fixed Income business, including revenue generation, cost management, and budget planning/monitoring.

• Define and execute the strategic direction of the Fixed Income Sales franchise, ensuring sustainable growth and market relevance.

• Provide comprehensive sales coverage of the Fixed Income product range (government bonds, SSAs, covered bonds, corporate bonds, private placements, etc.).

• Maintain and further develop senior client relationships with key Swiss and international institutional investors, acting as a trusted partner.

• Take full responsibility for Lead Manager and syndicate roles in primary market transactions, driving execution and coordination across internal and external stakeholders.

• Ensure the delivery of high-quality market intelligence, investment ideas, and product updates to clients.

• Act as a key interface with internal stakeholders (trading, research, structuring, treasury, risk, compliance), ensuring seamless execution and best-in-class client service.

• Monitor mar ket trends, regulatory developments, and competitor activity to position the franchise competitively.

What are we looking for?

• Advanced education in banking / finance; university degree or CFA / FRM is a strong plus.

• Extensive experience (typically 8–12+ years) in Fixed Income Sales, with a strong focus on CHF markets.

• Proven leadership experience, including managing teams and driving performance in a front-office environment.

• Demonstrated track record in revenue generation and client franchise development, with P&L responsibility preferred.

• Established and transferable client network among Swiss and international institutional investors.

• Deep understanding of fixed income products, primary and secondary markets, and regulatory frameworks.

• Strong commercial mindset, with the ability to translate market opportunities into revenue.

• Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills, with executive presence.

• Fluency in German (mandatory) and English; French and/or Italian is a strong asset.

• Entrepreneurial, team-oriented leader with the ability to perform under pressure and drive change.

What do we offer?

• Experienced, diverse team in an international environment.

• Agile environment in how we think, the way we work and our trust for each other.

• Flat hierarchy with collaboration at all levels.

• Collaborative spirit with opportunities to learn and thrive.

We are looking for talented people, not just a CV that ticks all the boxes. Even if you do not have absolutely everything we have asked for, if this role sounds like a good fit for you, we encourage you to apply.

At Vontobel, you are building better futures for our clients and society, as well as for yourself. By 2030, we want to be known as one of the leading and most trusted global investment firms. We have 2,300+ engaged professionals, based in 27 locations globally and headquartered in Zurich.

We are both majority family-owned and publicly listed. Our capacity for long-term focus, on topics such as sustainability, is underpinned by the security of the family’s 100-year commitment. Driven by an ownership mindset, you can unlock your potential and translate insights into opportunities. We are hiring talented individuals who are determined to delive

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sei pronto a assumere un ruolo di leadership e plasmare il futuro di un franchise di vendite e mercati finanziari fissi ad alto rendimento? Siamo alla ricerca di un nuovo capo di vendite di reddito fisso per avere successo la leadership attuale e sviluppare ulteriormente il nostro consolidato cliente istituzionale e mercato dei capitali. In qualità di capo delle vendite di reddito fisso, guiderà il franchising, combinando il coinvolgimento attivo del cliente con la leadership strategica e la responsabilità commerciale. Qual è il tuo ruolo?
• Guida e gestisci il team Fixed Income Sales (5 FTEs), promuovendo una cultura ad alte prestazioni, il talento di mentoring e garantendo una forte collaborazione tra le funzioni.
• Possedere alla P&L del business Fixed Income, tra cui la generazione di ricavi, la gestione dei costi e la pianificazione/monitoraggio del budget.
• Definire ed eseguire la direzione strategica del franchise Fixed Income Sales, garantendo una crescita sostenibile e una rilevanza del mercato.
• Fornire una copertura completa delle vendite della gamma di prodotti Fixed Income (obbligazioni governative, SSA, obbligazioni coperte, obbligazioni societarie, collocamenti privati, ecc.).
• Mantenere e sviluppare ulteriormente relazioni senior con gli investitori istituzionali svizzeri e internazionali, agendo come partner affidabile.
• Prendere la piena responsabilità per Lead Manager e sindacato ruoli nelle transazioni di mercato primario, l'esecuzione di guida e il coordinamento tra gli stakeholder interni ed esterni.
• Assicurare la consegna di intelligenza di mercato di alta qualità, idee di investimento e aggiornamenti di prodotto ai clienti.
• Agire come interfaccia chiave con gli stakeholder interni (trading, ricerca, strutturazione, tesoreria, rischio, conformità), assicurando l'esecuzione senza soluzione di continuità e il servizio client migliore in classe.
• Monitorare le tendenze, gli sviluppi normativi e l'attività dei concorrenti per posizionare il franchise in modo competitivo. Cosa stiamo cercando?
• Istruzione avanzata nel settore bancario / finanziario; laurea o CFA / FRM è un vantaggio forte.
• Ampia esperienza (di solito 8–12+ anni) in vendite a reddito fisso, con un forte focus sui mercati di CHF.
• Provata esperienza di leadership, tra cui team di gestione e prestazioni di guida in un ambiente di front-office.
• Demonstrated track record nella generazione di ricavi e sviluppo di franchising client, con P&L responsabilità preferita.
• Rete clienti fondata e trasferibile tra investitori istituzionali svizzeri e internazionali.
• Una profonda comprensione dei prodotti a reddito fisso, dei mercati primari e secondari e dei quadri normativi.
• Forte mentalità commerciale, con la capacità di tradurre le opportunità di mercato in ricavi.
• Ottima capacità di comunicazione, negoziazione e gestione degli stakeholder, con presenza esecutiva.
• Fluency in tedesco (obbligatorio) e inglese; francese e/o italiano è un bene forte.
• Leader imprenditoriale, orientato al team con la capacità di eseguire sotto pressione e cambio di unità. Cosa offriamo?
• Un team esperto e diversificato in un ambiente internazionale.
• Ambiente aggressivo in come pensiamo, il modo in cui lavoriamo e la nostra fiducia l'uno per l'altro.
• Gerarchia piatta con collaborazione a tutti i livelli.
• Spirito collaborativo con opportunità di imparare e prosperare. Stiamo cercando persone di talento, non solo un CV che ticchetta tutte le scatole. descriptionByLocale.en:
Are you ready to take on a leadership role and shape the future of a high-performing Fixed Income Sales and Capital Markets franchise?

We are looking for a new Head of Fixed Income Sales to succeed the current leadership and further develop our established institutional client and capital markets business.

As Head of Fixed Income Sales, you will lead the franchise, combining active client engagement with strategic leadership and commercial accountability.

What would your role be?

• Lead and manage the Fixed Income Sales team (5 FTEs), fostering a high-performance culture, mentoring talent, and ensuring strong collaboration across functions.

• Own the P&L of the Fixed Income business, including revenue generation, cost management, and budget planning/monitoring.

• Define and execute the strategic direction of the Fixed Income Sales franchise, ensuring sustainable growth and market relevance.

• Provide comprehensive sales coverage of the Fixed Income product range (government bonds, SSAs, covered bonds, corporate bonds, private placements, etc.).

• Maintain and further develop senior client relationships with key Swiss and international institutional investors, acting as a trusted partner.

• Take full responsibility for Lead Manager and syndicate roles in primary market transactions, driving execution and coordination across internal and external stakeholders.

• Ensure the delivery of high-quality market intelligence, investment ideas, and product updates to clients.

• Act as a key interface with internal stakeholders (trading, research, structuring, treasury, risk, compliance), ensuring seamless execution and best-in-class client service.

• Monitor mar ket trends, regulatory developments, and competitor activity to position the franchise competitively.

What are we looking for?

• Advanced education in banking / finance; university degree or CFA / FRM is a strong plus.

• Extensive experience (typically 8–12+ years) in Fixed Income Sales, with a strong focus on CHF markets.

• Proven leadership experience, including managing teams and driving performance in a front-office environment.

• Demonstrated track record in revenue generation and client franchise development, with P&L responsibility preferred.

• Established and transferable client network among Swiss and international institutional investors.

• Deep understanding of fixed income products, primary and secondary markets, and regulatory frameworks.

• Strong commercial mindset, with the ability to translate market opportunities into revenue.

• Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills, with executive presence.

• Fluency in German (mandatory) and English; French and/or Italian is a strong asset.

• Entrepreneurial, team-oriented leader with the ability to perform under pressure and drive change.

What do we offer?

• Experienced, diverse team in an international environment.

• Agile environment in how we think, the way we work and our trust for each other.

• Flat hierarchy with collaboration at all levels.

• Collaborative spirit with opportunities to learn and thrive.

We are looking for talented people, not just a CV that ticks all the boxes. Even if you do not have absolutely everything we have asked for, if this role sounds like a good fit for you, we encourage you to apply.

At Vontobel, you are building better futures for our clients and society, as well as for yourself. By 2030, we want to be known as one of the leading and most trusted global investment firms. We have 2,300+ engaged professionals, based in 27 locations globally and headquartered in Zurich.

We are both majority family-owned and publicly listed. Our capacity for long-term focus, on topics such as sustainability, is underpinned by the security of the family’s 100-year commitment. Driven by an ownership mindset, you can unlock your potential and translate insights into opportunities. We are hiring talented individuals who are determined to delive

jobs.description:
Are you passionate about delivering exceptional support and ensuring smooth operations in the financial world? We are looking for a highly motivated Specialist 1st Level Front Support to join our Service Hub team. This role is a key part of our organization, providing first-level support to Relationship Managers, Assistants, and the Front Office, ensuring they can deliver outstanding service to our clients.

Our team takes ownership, embraces challenges, and constantly seeks new ways to learn, develop, and improve. We are looking for a new team member who views every interaction as an opportunity to provide efficient, high-quality support and contribute to an excellent client experience. If you thrive in a dynamic environment and are eager to make a difference, we’d love to hear from you!

What would your role be?
As part of the Front Support team, you will play a crucial role as the first and most important point of contact for our Wealth Management Front Office employees. Your primary responsibility will be to provide assistance with general and operational issues, including system-related challenges, process inquiries, access rights, and more.
As a Specialist in 1st Level Front Support, your responsibilities will include:

• Troubleshooting and resolving first-level support issues promptly and effectively.

• Assisting with tools and technical issues to ensure smooth daily operations.

• Resolving access issues, base data challenges, and workflow-related queries.

• Supporting front-office processes and addressing general banking matters.

• Acting as a key point of contact to ensure operational excellence and enhance the client experience.

What are we looking for?
We are looking for a candidate who brings:

• Relevant experience in IT or a similar support role, ideally within wealth management or financial services.

• Solid knowledge of Wealth Management front-office processes, technical tools, and banking operations.

• Genuine passion for delivering personalized and direct phone support, maintaining a friendly, professional, and calm demeanor in high-pressure situations, while providing efficient and effective assistance to Wealth Management stakeholders.

• A hands-on approach, openness to tackling new topics, a strong helper mentality, curiosity, and a drive to understand and resolve problems sustainably.

• A client-focused mindset, proactive attitude, and attention to detail in identifying and resolving issues.

• Willingness to work onsite full-time to ensure close collaboration with the team and direct support for the Front Office.

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with oral and written proficiency in German (C2) and English (C1).

What do we offer?

• Top Zurich location with collaboration spaces (including rooftop terraces) and free lunch.

• Friendly, diverse team in an open-office space.

• All the latest technology to help you excel and advance.

• Agile environment in how we think, the way we work and our trust for each other.

• Flat hierarchy with collaboration at all levels.

• Campus feeling and a collaborative spirit.

We are looking for talented people, not just a CV that ticks all the boxes. Even if you do not have absolutely everything we have asked for, if this role sounds like a good fit for you, we encourage you to apply.

Why Vontobel?

At Vontobel, you are building better futures for our clients and society, as well as for yourself. As a family-owned and publicly listed company with over 2,000 professionals based in 28 locations globally and headquartered in Zurich, we’re committed to long-term thinking and sustainability.

Our diverse team values unique perspectives, and we hire individuals determined to deliver in a dynamic and changing world. Even if you don’t meet all the criteria, we encourage you to apply if you’re enthusiastic about the role.

Do you want to be Vontobel ?

Thank you for applying to Vontobel. We will carefully review your application and will respond to yo

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sei appassionato di fornire un supporto eccezionale e garantire operazioni fluide nel mondo finanziario? Siamo alla ricerca di uno specialista altamente motivato 1 ° livello di supporto anteriore per aderire al nostro team Service Hub. Questo ruolo è una parte fondamentale della nostra organizzazione, fornendo supporto di primo livello a Relationship Manager, Assistenti e Front Office, assicurando che possano fornire un servizio eccezionale ai nostri clienti. Il nostro team prende la proprietà, abbraccia le sfide, e cerca costantemente nuovi modi per imparare, sviluppare e migliorare. Siamo alla ricerca di un nuovo membro del team che vede ogni interazione come un'opportunità per fornire un supporto efficiente e di alta qualità e contribuire a un'esperienza cliente eccellente. Se si prospera in un ambiente dinamico e sono desiderosi di fare la differenza, ci piacerebbe sentire da voi! Qual è il tuo ruolo? Come parte del team di supporto anteriore, si svolgerà un ruolo cruciale come il primo e più importante punto di contatto per i nostri dipendenti Wealth Management Front Office. La vostra responsabilità primaria sarà quella di fornire assistenza a problemi generali e operativi, comprese le sfide legate al sistema, le indagini di processo, i diritti di accesso e altro ancora. Come Specialista nel primo livello di supporto frontale, le tue responsabilità includono:
• Risoluzione dei problemi e risoluzione di problemi di supporto di primo livello in modo rapido ed efficace.
• Assistere con strumenti e problemi tecnici per garantire operazioni quotidiane fluide.
• Risolvere i problemi di accesso, le sfide dei dati di base e le domande relative al flusso di lavoro.
• Sostenere i processi di front-office e affrontare questioni bancarie generali.
• Agire come punto di contatto chiave per garantire l'eccellenza operativa e migliorare l'esperienza del cliente. Cosa stiamo cercando? Stiamo cercando un candidato che porta:
• Esperienza rilevante in IT o un ruolo di supporto simile, idealmente all'interno di gestione della ricchezza o servizi finanziari.
• Conoscenza solida dei processi di front-office di Wealth Management, strumenti tecnici e operazioni bancarie.
• Genuina passione per la fornitura di supporto telefonico personalizzato e diretto, mantenendo un demeanor amichevole, professionale e calmo in situazioni di alta pressione, fornendo assistenza efficiente ed efficace agli stakeholder di Wealth Management.
• Un approccio pratico, apertura ad affrontare nuovi argomenti, una forte mentalità aiutante, curiosità e un desiderio di capire e risolvere i problemi in modo sostenibile.
• Una mentalità orientata al cliente, un atteggiamento proattivo e un'attenzione ai dettagli nell'identificazione e nella risoluzione dei problemi.
• Volontà di lavorare in loco a tempo pieno per garantire una stretta collaborazione con il team e il supporto diretto per il Front Office.
• Forte comunicazione e competenze interpersonali, con competenza orale e scritta in tedesco (C2) e inglese (C1). Cosa offriamo?
• Posizione top a Zurigo con spazi di collaborazione (tra cui terrazze sul tetto) e pranzo gratuito.
• Un team amichevole e diversificato in uno spazio aperto.
• Tutte le ultime tecnologie per aiutarti ad eccellere e avanzare.
• Ambiente aggressivo in come pensiamo, il modo in cui lavoriamo e la nostra fiducia l'uno per l'altro.
• Gerarchia piatta con collaborazione a tutti i livelli.
• Il sentimento del campus e lo spirito collaborativo. Stiamo cercando persone di talento, non solo un CV che ticchetta tutte le scatole. Anche se non avete assolutamente tutto quello che abbiamo chiesto, se questo ruolo suona come una buona misura per voi, vi incoraggiamo ad applicare. Perché Vontobel? A Vontobel, stai costruendo un futuro migliore per i nostri clienti e la società, così come per te. Come azienda di proprietà familiare e quotata in pubblico con oltre 2.000 professionisti con sede in 28 sedi a livello globale e con sede a Zurigo, ci impegniamo a pensare e sostenibilità a lungo termine. Il nostro team diversificato valorizza prospettive uniche, e assumere individui determinati a fornire in un mondo dinamico e mutevole. Anche se non soddisfate tutti i criteri, vi incoraggiamo ad applicare se siete entusiasti del ruolo. Vuoi essere Vontobel? Grazie per aver fatto domanda a Vontobel. Rivedremo attentamente la vostra applicazione e risponderemo a yo

• Unterstützung bei Tools und technischen Problemen, um einen reibungslosen täglichen Betrieb zu gewährleisten.
• Beheben von Zugriffsproblemen, Basisdatenherausforderungen und Workflow-bezogenen Abfragen.
• Unterstützung von Front-Office-Prozessen und allgemeine Bankangelegenheiten.
• Als wichtiger Ansprechpartner, um operative Exzellenz zu gewährleisten und die Kundenerfahrung zu verbessern. Worauf warten wir? Wir suchen einen Kandidaten, der bringt:

• Fundierte Kenntnisse über Wealth Management Front-Office-Prozesse, technische Tools und Bankgeschäfte.
• Echte Leidenschaft für die Bereitstellung von personalisiertem und direktem Telefonsupport, die Aufrechterhaltung eines freundlichen, professionellen und ruhigen Auftretens in Hochdrucksituationen und gleichzeitig eine effiziente und effektive Unterstützung für die Stakeholder von Wealth Management.

• Eine kundenorientierte Denkweise, eine proaktive Haltung und die Liebe zum Detail bei der Identifizierung und Lösung von Problemen.
• Bereitschaft, Vollzeit vor Ort zu arbeiten, um eine enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem Team und direkte Unterstützung für das Front Office zu gewährleisten.
• Starke Kommunikation und zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten, mit mündlichen und schriftlichen Kenntnissen in Deutsch (C2) und Englisch (C1). Was bieten wir an?
• Top Zürich Lage mit Collaboration Spaces (einschließlich Dachterrassen) und kostenlosem Mittagessen.

jobs.description:
Are you ready to operate at the core of a leading Investment Solution franchise?
We are looking for an experienced Exotic Derivatives Trader to join our Zurich-based team, within a market-leading team.

This role combines trading at its core, with direct exposure to franchise development and business expansion across global markets.

What would your role be?

• Manage and oversee risk across our exotic trading books, actively driving P&L through disciplined positioning

• Execute and manage trading strategies on complex exotic structures, ensuring efficient hedging and risk allocation

• Ensure robust, consistent pricing and marking standards

• Deliver high-quality execution and responsiveness to internal stakeholders and clients

• Play a key role in growing the business, identifying opportunities to expand product offering, flows, and client activity, working with colleagues across all continents

• Actively contribute to the scaling of the franchise, supported by strong internal resources

• Work closely with Sales, Structuring, and Technology to enhance trading capabilities

What are we looking for?

We are looking for a strong trading profile with a clear risk-taking mindset and growth ambition:

• A strong financial background with a degree in Engineering, Finance, or a related field

• Proven experience in exotic derivatives trading within a competitive environment

• Quantitative and risk-focused mindset, with a clear approach to managing books and generating performance

In this role, you will play a key part in designing, implementing, and maintaining systems and interfaces that drive the digitalization of our internal processes. Our modern technology stack includes Java/Kotlin, Kafka, Spring Boot, and OpenShift (Docker).
We are seeking a proactive and communicative individual who enjoys collaborating with stakeholders, translating business needs into technical solutions, and taking ownership from concept to delivery. You will thrive in a collaborative, inclusive, and innovative environment where continuous learning and improvement are encouraged. If this sounds like you, we’d love to hear your story and what motivates you.

What would your role be?

• Develop internal applications and/or configure commercial off-the-shelf solutions (e.g., Atlassian Jira) to meet business needs and enhance operational efficiency.

• Take ownership of new initiatives, including stakeholder alignment, requirements engineering, solution design, and system architecture, ensuring scalable and sustainable outcomes.

• Collaborate closely with business stakeholders to gather, clarify, and prioritize requirements, acting as a bridge between technical and non-technical teams.

• Participate in code reviews and contribute to the continuous improvement of development practices, processes, and standards.

• Create and maintain clear and comprehensive documentation for software features, processes, and workflows to ensure transparency and usability.

• Act as a trusted partner by troubleshooting and resolving application issues, ensuring stable and reliable operations.

What are we looking for?

• A bachelor’s degree in computer science, a related field, or a completed software engineering apprenticeship

• Solid experience with Java/Kotlin and a proven track record of delivering high-quality software solutions

• 5+ years of hands-on experience in software development, showcasing your ability to tackle complex challenges and deliver impactful results

• Strong communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams and explain technical concepts clearly

• Knowledge of Atlassian tools, particularly in configuring and operating Jira and/or willingness to develop such skills

• A growth mindset: You’re eager to learn, take responsibility, and continuously develop yourself.

• Good communication skills in English (mandatory) and German (highly desirable)

What do we offer?

• Top Zurich location with collaboration spaces and free lunch.

• Friendly, diverse team in an open-office space.

• All the latest technology to help you excel and advance.

• Agile environment in how we think, the way we work and our trust for each other.

• Flat hierarchy with collaboration on all levels.

• Campus feeling and collaborative spirit.

We are looking for talented people, not just a CV that ticks all the boxes. Even if you do not have absolutely everything we have asked for, if this role sounds like a good fit for you, we encourage you to apply.

At Vontobel, you are building better futures for our clients and society, as well as for yourself. As a family-owned and publicly listed company with over 2,000 professionals based in 28 locations globally and headquartered in Zurich, we’re committed to long-term thinking and sustainability.

jobs.description:
Within our Data & AI Solutions Hub, we design, build and operate the enterprise AI platform for Vontobel on Microsoft AI Foundry, Azure and the Power Platform. We are looking for a hands-on senior engineer who delivers production-grade GenAI and agentic solutions, turns them into reusable patterns the wider organisation can build upon, and raises the engineering standard for everyone around them. This is a pro-code role at the centre of how the bank adopts AI responsibly, in a Zurich-based team that values judgement as highly as technical depth.

What would your role be?

• Design, build and operate production-grade agentic and GenAI solutions on Microsoft AI Foundry, taking them from prototype through to governed, observable, and fully supported production services.

• Translate recurring business needs into reusable reference architectures and paved-road patterns, so that each new use case builds on a secure, proven foundation rather than starting from scratch.

• Set the pro-code engineering standard for AI across the team, and mentor colleagues working in both pro-code and low-code environments (Copilot Studio, Power Platform) so that good practice scales beyond any individual.

• Make the secure and compliant path the most straightforward path for business teams, by building enablement and self-service into the platform rather than absorbing demand as manual support.

• Treat governance, data classification, identity, and responsible-AI guardrails as integral to the engineering itself — in a regulated banking environment, sound judgement about what not to build is as valuable as the ability to build it.

What are we looking for?

• Demonstrable experience taking at least one agentic or GenAI system from prototype into production within a sensitive or regulated environment, including responsibility for its operation. We will ask you to walk us through what you built, who relied on it, the hardest constraint you designed around, and what you would approach differently today.

• Strong pro-code engineering foundations, with proven proficiency in Python for AI and agent development, complemented by production software experience in at least one of C#/.NET or TypeScript. You write code regularly and intend to keep doing so.

• Hands-on depth in Microsoft AI Foundry and Azure AI services — retrieval-augmented generation, orchestration, evaluation, and agent design patterns.

• Familiarity with Microsoft Fabric and the Power Platform (including Copilot Studio) is an advantage.

• A first-principles approach to security, data boundaries, and architectural trade-offs, and the confidence to advise a business team against a given approach when circumstances require it.

• A track record of improving the engineers and standards around you — through mentoring, technical leadership, or setting team-wide practice — not solely through individual delivery.

• The ability to learn quickly in a rapidly evolving technology landscape. We are recruiting for your learning ability and judgement, not for a fixed list of certifications.

• Fluency in English is required; German is a strong advantage given close collaboration with business stakeholders.

What do we offer?

• Top Zurich location with collaboration spaces and free lunch.

• Friendly, diverse team in an open-office space.

• All the latest technology to help you excel and advance.

• Agile environment in how we think, the way we work and our trust for each other.

• Flat hierarchy with collaboration on all levels.

• Campus feeling and collaborative spirit.

We are looking for talented people, not just a CV that ticks all the boxes. Even if you do not have absolutely everything we have asked for, if this role sounds like a good fit for you, we encourage you to apply.

Why Vontobel?
At Vontobel, you are building better futures for our clients and society, as well as for yourself. As a family-owned and publicly listed company with over 2,000 professionals based in 28 locations globally

descriptionByLocale.it:
All'interno del nostro Data & AI Solutions Hub, progettiamo, costruiamo e gestiamo la piattaforma AI aziendale per Vontobel su Microsoft AI Foundry, Azure e la Power Platform. Siamo alla ricerca di un ingegnere senior pratico che offre soluzioni GenAI e agentic di qualità della produzione, li trasforma in modelli riutilizzabili su cui la più ampia organizzazione può costruire, e solleva lo standard di ingegneria per tutti intorno a loro. Si tratta di un ruolo pro-codice al centro di come la banca adotta l'IA responsabilmente, in un team di Zurigo che valorizza il giudizio come profondità tecnica. Qual è il tuo ruolo?
• Progettare, costruire e operare soluzioni agentiche e GenAI di livello produttivo su Microsoft AI Foundry, prendendole dal prototipo fino ai servizi di produzione governati, osservabili e pienamente supportati.
• Traduci le esigenze di business ricorrenti in architetture di riferimento riutilizzabili e modelli asfaltati-road, in modo che ogni nuovo caso di utilizzo si costruisce su una fondazione sicura e collaudata piuttosto che a partire da zero.
• Impostare lo standard di ingegneria di codice pro per l'intelligenza artificiale in tutto il team, e i colleghi di mentore che lavorano sia in ambienti pro-codice che in basso codice (Copilot Studio, Power Platform) in modo che la buona pratica scale oltre ogni individuo.
• Rendere il percorso sicuro e conforme il percorso più semplice per i team aziendali, costruendo abilitazione e self-service nella piattaforma piuttosto che assorbire la domanda come supporto manuale.
• Trattare la governance, la classificazione dei dati, l'identità e i guardrails responsabili-AI come parte integrante dell'ingegneria stessa — in un ambiente bancario regolamentato, il giudizio sonoro su ciò che non costruire è tanto prezioso quanto la capacità di costruirlo. Cosa stiamo cercando?
• Esperienza dimostrabile prendendo almeno un sistema agente o GenAI dal prototipo alla produzione all'interno di un ambiente sensibile o regolamentato, compresa la responsabilità del suo funzionamento. Vi chiederemo di accompagnarci attraverso ciò che avete costruito, che ci ha fatto affidamento, il vincolo più duro che avete progettato intorno, e ciò che vi sarebbe avvicinato in modo diverso oggi.
• Forte fondazioni di ingegneria pro-codice, con comprovata competenza in Python per lo sviluppo di AI e agente, completato da esperienza di software di produzione in almeno uno di C#/.NET o TypeScript. Lei scrive il codice regolarmente e intende continuare a farlo.
• Hands-on profondità in Microsoft AI Foundry e Azure AI servizi — generazione, orchestrazione, valutazione e modelli di progettazione di agente recuperati.
• La familiarità con Microsoft Fabric e la Power Platform (incluso Copilot Studio) è un vantaggio.
• Un primo principio si avvicina alla sicurezza, ai confini dei dati e ai trade-off architettonici, e alla fiducia di consigliare un team aziendale contro un dato approccio quando le circostanze lo richiedono.
• Un track record di miglioramento degli ingegneri e degli standard intorno a voi — attraverso il mentoring, la leadership tecnica, o l'impostazione della pratica di squadra — non solo attraverso la consegna individuale.
• La capacità di imparare rapidamente in un panorama tecnologico in rapida evoluzione. Stiamo reclutando per la vostra capacità di apprendimento e giudizio, non per una lista fissa di certificazioni.
• Il tedesco è un forte vantaggio dato dalla stretta collaborazione con gli stakeholder aziendali. Cosa offriamo?
• Posizione top a Zurigo con spazi di collaborazione e pranzo gratuito.
• Un team amichevole e diversificato in uno spazio aperto.
• Tutte le ultime tecnologie per aiutarti ad eccellere e avanzare.
• Ambiente aggressivo in come pensiamo, il modo in cui lavoriamo e la nostra fiducia l'uno per l'altro.
• Gerarchia piatta con collaborazione su tutti i livelli.
• Il sentimento del campus e lo spirito collaborativo. Stiamo cercando persone di talento, non solo un CV che ticchetta tutte le scatole. Anche se non avete assolutamente tutto quello che abbiamo chiesto, se questo ruolo suona come una buona misura per voi, vi incoraggiamo ad applicare. Perché Vontobel? A Vontobel, stai costruendo un futuro migliore per i nostri clienti e la società, così come per te. Come azienda a conduzione familiare e quotata in pubblico con oltre 2.000 professionisti con sede in 28 sedi a livello globale

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Au sein de notre Data & AI Solutions Hub, nous concevons, construisons et exploitons la plate-forme d'entreprise AI pour Vontobel sur Microsoft AI Foundry, Azure et la plate-forme d'alimentation. Nous sommes à la recherche d'un ingénieur senior pratique qui fournit des solutions GenAI de qualité de production et d'agents, les transforme en modèles réutilisables sur lesquels l'organisation plus large peut s'appuyer, et élève la norme d'ingénierie pour tous autour d'eux. C'est un rôle pro-code au centre de la façon dont la banque adopte l'IA de manière responsable, dans une équipe basée à Zurich qui valorise le jugement aussi hautement que la profondeur technique. Quel serait votre rôle ?
• Concevoir, construire et exploiter des solutions d'agent de qualité de production et GenAI sur Microsoft AI Foundry, en les faisant passer du prototype à des services de production régis, observables et entièrement pris en charge.
• Traduire les besoins d'affaires récurrents en architectures de référence réutilisables et en motifs de route pavée, de sorte que chaque nouveau cas d'utilisation s'appuie sur une base sûre et éprouvée plutôt que de partir de zéro.
• Définir la norme d'ingénierie pro-code pour l'IA dans toute l'équipe, et mentor collègues travaillant à la fois dans les environnements pro-code et bas-code (Copilot Studio, Power Platform) afin que les bonnes pratiques s'étendent au-delà de toute personne.
• Faire du chemin sécurisé et conforme le chemin le plus simple pour les équipes d'affaires, en construisant l'activation et le libre-service dans la plate-forme plutôt que d'absorber la demande comme support manuel.
• Traiter la gouvernance, la classification des données, l'identité et les garde-corps responsables comme faisant partie intégrante de l'ingénierie elle-même — dans un environnement bancaire réglementé, un jugement sérieux sur ce qui ne doit pas être construit est aussi précieux que la capacité de le construire. Qu'est-ce qu'on cherche ?
• Expérience démontrée en utilisant au moins un système agentique ou GenAI du prototype à la production dans un environnement sensible ou réglementé, y compris la responsabilité de son fonctionnement. Nous vous demanderons de nous guider dans ce que vous avez construit, qui s'en fiait, la contrainte la plus dure que vous ayez conçue et ce que vous approcheriez différemment aujourd'hui.
• Fortes fondations d'ingénierie pro-code, avec une compétence prouvée en Python pour l'IA et le développement d'agents, complétée par une expérience logiciel de production dans au moins un de C#/.NET ou TypeScript. Vous écrivez régulièrement du code et vous comptez continuer à le faire.
• Profondeur pratique dans les services Microsoft AI Foundry et Azure AI – génération augmentée, orchestration, évaluation et modèles d'agents.
• La familiarité avec Microsoft Fabric et la Power Platform (y compris Copilot Studio) est un avantage.
• Une approche axée sur les premiers principes en matière de sécurité, de limites de données et de compromis architecturaux, et la confiance pour conseiller une équipe d'affaires contre une approche donnée lorsque les circonstances l'exigent.
• Une expérience d'amélioration des ingénieurs et des normes autour de vous — par le mentorat, le leadership technique ou l'établissement de pratiques à l'échelle de l'équipe — pas seulement par la prestation individuelle.
• La capacité d'apprendre rapidement dans un paysage technologique en évolution rapide. Nous recrutons pour votre capacité d'apprentissage et votre jugement, et non pour une liste fixe de certifications.
• La maîtrise de l'anglais est nécessaire; l'allemand est un avantage important grâce à une collaboration étroite avec les parties prenantes. Qu'est-ce qu'on offre ?
• Haut de Zurich avec des espaces de collaboration et déjeuner gratuit.
• Équipe amicale et diversifiée dans un espace ouvert.
• Toutes les dernières technologies pour vous aider à exceller et à progresser.
• Environnement agile dans notre façon de penser, notre façon de travailler et notre confiance les uns pour les autres.
• Hiérarchie plate avec collaboration à tous les niveaux.
• Sensation de campus et esprit de collaboration. Nous cherchons des gens talentueux, pas seulement un CV qui coche toutes les boîtes. Même si vous n'avez pas absolument tout ce que nous avons demandé, si ce rôle vous semble bon, nous vous encourageons à postuler. Pourquoi Vontobel ? Chez Vontobel, vous construisez de meilleurs avenirs pour nos clients et notre société, ainsi que pour vous-même. En tant qu'entreprise familiale et cotée en bourse avec plus de 2 000 professionnels basés dans 28 sites à l'échelle mondiale

jobs.title: Transactional Tax Specialist
jobs.description:
Are you flexible, quick to adapt, and able to integrate into a new team? Do you have a passion for working with numbers and the ability to see both the fine details and the big picture? Are you looking for a position in a dynamic and engaging environment that lets you delve into complex tax and regulatory matters? Are you energized by the opportunity to question the status quo and optimize processes and services?

At Vontobel, we invest in people who shape the client’s experience of tomorrow. In our Reporting Services Team in Zurich, you'll join an experienced team managing numerous regulatory reporting and tax services. As a Regulatory Tax Specialist, you will collaborate closely with your IT and business colleagues to achieve shared goals, take ownership of application components and processes, address operational challenges, and contribute to ongoing projects. Together, we deliver high-quality tax services and support internal and external stakeholders with thorough and insightful service.

What would your role be?

• Withholding & transaction tax processing: monitor, deposit, and report on various withholding and transaction taxes, including Swiss turnover tax, Swiss and foreign withholding taxes, and financial transaction taxes (e.g. Spain/Italy/France transaction tax).

• Regulatory tax reporting: plan, support, and coordinate the annual reporting for AIA/CRS, ensuring accurate and timely compliance.

• Inquiry processing & support: analyze and respond to Transaction Tax and CRS related inquiries from all areas of the bank, as well as from external clients, providing professional insights and solutions.

• Implementation of changes: monitor publications of regulatory updates and implement required technical and procedural changes in close collaboration with IT specialists.

• Department representation & process optimization: act as a knowledgeable and reliable representative of the department in bank-wide projects and process enhancement initiatives related to your regulatory reporting and transaction tax topics.

• Process & service development: Pursue the shared goals of regulatory compliance, client satisfaction, quality improvement, efficiency gains, and ensure smooth operations.

What are we looking for?

• A degree in banking & finance, business administration or similar with several years of relevant professional experience in the banking and finance sector.

• Several years of experience in the subject area of Swiss and international Transaction Taxation is a requirement.

• A proactive and independent approach to work, with strong organizational skills and a willingness to take ownership of your work.

• Good analytical skills, a “can-do” mindset, and the ability to work independently.

• A collaborative team player with effective communication skills.

• Proficiency in both German and English.

What do we offer?

• Top Zurich location with collaboration spaces (including rooftop terraces) and free lunch.

• Friendly, diverse team in an open-office space.

• All the latest technology to help you excel and advance.

• Agile environment in how we think, the way we work and our trust for each other.

• Flat hierarchy with collaboration at all levels.

• Campus feeling and a collaborative spirit.

We are looking for talented people, not just a CV that ticks all the boxes. Even if you do not have absolutely everything we have asked for, if this role sounds like a good fit for you, we encourage you to apply.

Why Vontobel?

At Vontobel, you are building better futures for our clients and society, as well as for yourself. As a family-owned and publicly listed company with over 2,000 professionals based in 28 locations globally and headquarters in Zurich, we’re committed to long-term thinking and sustainability.

Our diverse team values unique perspectives, and we hire individuals determined to deliver in a dynamic and changing world. Even if you don’t meet all the criteria, we encourage you to apply if you’re enthusias

Stai cercando una posizione in un ambiente dinamico e coinvolgente che ti permette di approfondire questioni fiscali e regolamentari complesse? Sei eccitato dall'opportunità di mettere in discussione lo status quo e ottimizzare i processi e i servizi? A Vontobel, investiamo in persone che plasmano l’esperienza del cliente di domani. Nel nostro Reporting Services Team di Zurigo, ti unirai a un team esperto che gestirà numerosi report e servizi fiscali. Come Specialista fiscale regolamentare, collaborerai a stretto contatto con i tuoi colleghi IT e business per raggiungere obiettivi condivisi, prendere la proprietà di componenti e processi applicativi, affrontare le sfide operative e contribuire a progetti in corso. Insieme, forniamo servizi fiscali di alta qualità e supportiamo gli stakeholder interni ed esterni con un servizio approfondito e approfondito. Qual è il tuo ruolo?
• Ritiro e trattamento fiscale delle transazioni: monitoraggio, deposito e report sulle varie imposte di ritenuta e di transazione, inclusa l'imposta sulla cifra d'affari svizzera, le tasse di ritenuta estere e le imposte sulle transazioni finanziarie (ad esempio la tassa sulle transazioni in Spagna/Italia/Francia).
• Resoconto fiscale regolamentare: pianificare, sostenere e coordinare il reporting annuale per AIA/CRS, assicurando la conformità accurata e tempestiva.
• Elaborazione delle richieste e supporto: analizzare e rispondere alle richieste di Transaction Tax e CRS da tutte le aree della banca, nonché da clienti esterni, fornendo informazioni e soluzioni professionali.
• Attuazione delle modifiche: monitorare le pubblicazioni degli aggiornamenti normativi e implementare modifiche tecniche e procedurali richieste in stretta collaborazione con specialisti IT.
• Rappresentazione del Dipartimento e ottimizzazione dei processi: agire come un rappresentante competente e affidabile del dipartimento in progetti bancari e iniziative di miglioramento dei processi relativi ai tuoi temi regolamentari di reporting e tassa sulle transazioni.
• Sviluppo di processi e servizi:seguire gli obiettivi condivisi di conformità normativa, soddisfazione del cliente, miglioramento della qualità, guadagni di efficienza e garantire operazioni fluide. Cosa stiamo cercando?
• Una laurea in finanza, amministrazione aziendale o simile con diversi anni di esperienza professionale rilevante nel settore bancario e finanziario.
• Diversi anni di esperienza nell'area tematica della tassazione delle transazioni svizzere e internazionali è un requisito.
• Un approccio proattivo e indipendente al lavoro, con forti capacità organizzative e la volontà di prendere possesso del vostro lavoro.
• Buone abilità analitiche, una mentalità “can-do” e la capacità di lavorare indipendentemente.
• Un team player collaborativo con competenze di comunicazione efficaci.
• Competenza sia in tedesco che in inglese. Cosa offriamo?
• Posizione top a Zurigo con spazi di collaborazione (tra cui terrazze sul tetto) e pranzo gratuito.
• Un team amichevole e diversificato in uno spazio aperto.
• Tutte le ultime tecnologie per aiutarti ad eccellere e avanzare.
• Ambiente aggressivo in come pensiamo, il modo in cui lavoriamo e la nostra fiducia l'uno per l'altro.
• Gerarchia piatta con collaborazione a tutti i livelli.
• Il sentimento del campus e lo spirito collaborativo. Stiamo cercando persone di talento, non solo un CV che ticchetta tutte le scatole. Anche se non avete assolutamente tutto quello che abbiamo chiesto, se questo ruolo suona come una buona misura per voi, vi incoraggiamo ad applicare. Perché Vontobel? A Vontobel, stai costruendo un futuro migliore per i nostri clienti e la società, così come per te. Come azienda di proprietà familiare e quotata in pubblico con oltre 2.000 professionisti con sede in 28 sedi a livello globale e sede a Zurigo, ci impegniamo a pensare e sostenibilità a lungo termine. Il nostro team diversificato valorizza prospettive uniche, e assumere individui determinati a fornire in un mondo dinamico e mutevole. Anche se non soddisfate tutti i criteri, vi incoraggiamo ad applicare se siete appassionati

• Manage and resolve tickets as part of Incident and Service Request Management processes.

• Expertise in Microsoft Windows client environments and the Microsoft Office suite, with strong proficiency in Windows 11 and M365.

• Knowledge of networking, IP telephony, and printing systems.

• Familiarity with multimedia and conferencing systems used for presentations and virtual meetings.

• Flexibility to work outside regular service hours when needed and willingness to travel for short-term assignments at national and international offices.

• A service-oriented, analytical, and solution-focused approach, with the ability to adapt quickly to changing priorities.

• A motivated, trustworthy, and dependable team player who can also work effectively independently.

jobs.description:
Are you flexible, quick to adapt, and able to integrate into a new team? Do you thrive in dynamic environments and enjoy diverse, hands-on activities? Are you an IT enthusiast with a keen interest in the financial sector, eager to work with cutting-edge technologies, advanced IT infrastructures, and innovative methods? At Vontobel, we invest in people who shape the client experience of tomorrow. In our Reporting Services Team in Zurich, you'll join an experienced team managing numerous regulatory reporting services.

As an Avaloq Parametrization Specialist, you will be an integral part of the Reporting Services Team within the Operation Services Department. In this role, you will collaborate closely with your IT and business colleagues to achieve shared goals, take ownership of application components, address operational challenges, and contribute to ongoing projects. You will play a key role in maintaining and expanding our core banking system, Avaloq, while driving innovation and operational excellence.

What would your role be?

• Parametrization in our core banking system, Avaloq, with a primary focus on our transaction and regulation reporting services under Swiss and European legislation.

• Perform additional Avaloq reporting parametrization activities such as derivative reporting requirements.

• Drive developments forward together with the business experts, perform in-depth requirements analyses, implement new regulatory requirements and process innovations.

• Get involved with solution design, as well as programming, parametrization, and testing to ensure the availability of business-critical regulatory services and to support bank-wide platform projects.

• Pursue the shared goals of regulatory compliance, client satisfaction, quality improvement, efficiency gains, and ensure smooth operations.

• Affinity for Artificial Intelligence (AI) and a willingness to embrace AI-enabled tools and ways of working.

What are we looking for?

• Several years of software engineering experience in the banking and finance sector.

• Relevant Avaloq parametrization experience and a willingness to continuously acquire new knowledge in this area.

• Initial experience with regulatory transaction reporting, such as FinfraG, MiFID II, EMIR, and/or trading related knowledge (STEX) would be beneficial.

• Enthusiasm for new technologies, motivation to master technical knowledge in the complex field of regulatory transaction reporting and the ability to take responsibility.

• Very good communication skills in English and German are mandatory.

• Strong teamwork skills and a willingness to take ownership of your work and personal growth.

• Good analytical skills, solution-oriented mindset, and the ability to work independently.

What do we offer?

• Top Zurich location with collaboration spaces (including rooftop terraces) and free lunch.

• Friendly, diverse team in an open-office space.

• All the latest technology to help you excel and advance.

• Agile environment in how we think, the way we work and our trust for each other.

• Flat hierarchy with collaboration at all levels.

• Campus feeling and a collaborative spirit.

We are looking for talented people, not just a CV that ticks all the boxes. Even if you do not have absolutely everything we have asked for, if this role sounds like a good fit for you, we encourage you to apply.

Why Vontobel?
At Vontobel, you are building better futures for our clients and society, as well as for yourself. As a family-owned and publicly listed company with over 2,000 professionals based in 28 locations globally and headquartered in Zurich, we’re committed to long-term thinking and sustainability.
Our diverse team values unique perspectives, and we hire individuals determined to deliver in a dynamic and changing world. Even if you don’t meet all the criteria, we encourage you to apply if you’re enthusiastic about the role.

Sei un appassionato di IT con un vivo interesse per il settore finanziario, desideroso di lavorare con tecnologie all'avanguardia, infrastrutture IT avanzate e metodi innovativi? A Vontobel, investiamo in persone che modellano l'esperienza cliente di domani. Nel nostro Reporting Services Team di Zurigo, ti unirai a un team esperto che gestisce numerosi servizi di reporting normativo. In qualità di Avaloq Parametrization Specialist, sarai parte integrante del Reporting Services Team all'interno del Dipartimento Servizi Operativi. In questo ruolo, collaborerai a stretto contatto con i tuoi colleghi IT e business per raggiungere obiettivi condivisi, prendere la proprietà dei componenti applicativi, affrontare le sfide operative e contribuire a progetti in corso. Si svolgerà un ruolo chiave nel mantenere e espandere il nostro sistema bancario di base, Avaloq, mentre guida l'innovazione e l'eccellenza operativa. Qual è il tuo ruolo?
• Parametrizzazione nel nostro sistema bancario centrale, Avaloq, con un focus primario sui nostri servizi di reporting delle transazioni e dei regolamenti ai sensi della legislazione svizzera ed europea.
• Eseguire ulteriori attività di parametrizzazione di report Avaloq come i requisiti di report derivati.
• Guidare gli sviluppi in avanti insieme agli esperti aziendali, eseguire analisi approfondite dei requisiti, implementare nuovi requisiti normativi e innovazioni di processo.
• Partecipa alla progettazione di soluzioni, alla programmazione, alla parametrizzazione e al collaudo per garantire la disponibilità di servizi di regolamentazione business-critical e sostenere progetti di piattaforma su scala bancaria.
• Perseguire gli obiettivi condivisi di conformità normativa, soddisfazione del cliente, miglioramento della qualità, guadagni di efficienza e garantire operazioni fluide.
• L'affinità per l'intelligenza artificiale (AI) e la volontà di abbracciare strumenti e modi di lavoro abilitati all'intelligenza artificiale. Cosa stiamo cercando?
• Diversi anni di esperienza di ingegneria del software nel settore bancario e finanziario.
• Rilevante Avaloq esperienza di parametrizzazione e la volontà di acquisire continuamente nuove conoscenze in questa zona.
• L'esperienza iniziale con il reporting delle transazioni regolamentari, come FinfraG, MiFID II, EMIR e/o le conoscenze relative al trading (STEX) sarebbe utile.
• Entusiasmo per le nuove tecnologie, motivazione a padroneggiare le conoscenze tecniche nel complesso campo del reporting delle transazioni regolamentari e la capacità di assumersi la responsabilità.
• Molto buone capacità di comunicazione in inglese e tedesco sono obbligatori.
• Forte abilità di lavoro di squadra e la volontà di prendere la proprietà del vostro lavoro e la crescita personale.
• Buone competenze analitiche, mentalità orientata alla soluzione, e la capacità di lavorare indipendentemente. Cosa offriamo?
• Posizione top a Zurigo con spazi di collaborazione (tra cui terrazze sul tetto) e pranzo gratuito.
• Un team amichevole e diversificato in uno spazio aperto.
• Tutte le ultime tecnologie per aiutarti ad eccellere e avanzare.
• Ambiente aggressivo in come pensiamo, il modo in cui lavoriamo e la nostra fiducia l'uno per l'altro.
• Gerarchia piatta con collaborazione a tutti i livelli.
• Il sentimento del campus e lo spirito collaborativo. Stiamo cercando persone di talento, non solo un CV che ticchetta tutte le scatole. Anche se non avete assolutamente tutto quello che abbiamo chiesto, se questo ruolo suona come una buona misura per voi, vi incoraggiamo ad applicare. Perché Vontobel? A Vontobel, stai costruendo un futuro migliore per i nostri clienti e la società, così come per te. Come azienda di proprietà familiare e quotata in pubblico con oltre 2.000 professionisti con sede in 28 sedi a livello globale e con sede a Zurigo, ci impegniamo a pensare e sostenibilità a lungo termine. Il nostro team diversificato valorizza prospettive uniche, e assumere individui determinati a fornire in un mondo dinamico e mutevole. Anche se non soddisfate tutti i criteri, vi incoraggiamo ad applicare se siete entusiasti del ruolo. Vuoi essere Vontobel? Grazie per aver fatto domanda a Vontobel. Ci siamo.

jobs.title: Software Engineer Output Management, 80–100 %
jobs.description:
Interessierst du dich dafür, moderne IT-Lösungen in der Finanzindustrie aktiv mitzugestalten und skalierbare Kundenkommunikation zu entwickeln?

Dann werde Teil unseres Teams und treibe gemeinsam mit uns die Weiterentwicklung unserer Output-Management-Plattform (Customer Communications Management) sowie unserer Archivierungs- und Scanning-Lösungen für die gesamte Vontobel-Gruppe voran.

Wir suchen eine engagierte, praxisorientierte Persönlichkeit mit End-to-End-Verständnis, die Verantwortung übernimmt und sich an der Schnittstelle zwischen Business und IT wohlfühlt.

Was wären Ihre Tätigkeiten?

• Verantwortung für Ausbau, Betrieb und Weiterentwicklung der Output-Management-(CCM)-Plattform sowie Mitwirkung an Archivierungs- und Scanning-Lösungen.

• Analyse von Anforderungen zusammen mit den Fachbereichen und Umsetzung in skalierbare technische Lösungen.

• Konzeption, Entwicklung, Konfiguration und Testing inkl. Release- und Deployment-Begleitung (in Zusammenarbeit mit internen und externen Partnern, z. B. Quadient).

• Entwicklung und Betrieb von End-to-End-Lösungen entlang des gesamten Dokumentenprozesses (Rendering, Output Management, Integration).

• Sicherstellung von Stabilität, Performance und Verfügbarkeit der verantworteten Applikationen.

• Zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Business und IT mit Fokus auf durchgängiges Prozessverständnis.

jobs.description:

Genau das können wir dir hier bei Vontobel bieten.

Deine Möglichkeit:

• Mit unserer IT-Lehre wirst du zum Tech-Profi mit eidgenössischem Fähigkeitszeugnis Informatiker/in.

• Die Informatiker/innen bei uns entwickeln, realisieren, installieren, testen, betreiben und unterhalten Informatiklösungen.

• In der Position als Plattformentwickler bringen wir dir eine Vielzahl von Fähigkeiten und Technologien bei, die notwendig sind, um skalierbare, robuste und benutzerfreundliche Plattformen zu entwickeln und zu betreiben.

• Du wirst erste Erfahrungen in der Softwareentwicklung sammeln, somit lernen zu programmieren, erfahren was Datenbanken und APIs / Microservices sind und vieles mehr.

Das bringst du mit:

• Guter bis sehr guter Abschluss der Sekundarschule A oder der gegliederten Oberstufe in der Stammklasse mit erweiterten Anforderungen.

• Notendurchschnitt mindestens 4.5 in den Hauptfächern (Deutsch, Französisch, Englisch und Mathematik).

• Guter Multicheck ICT.

• Du möchtest Probleme identifizieren und lösen?

• Hast Interesse am Bankgeschäft und an wirtschaftlichen Zusammenhängen.

• Erste Kenntnisse und Interesse für IT.

• Initiative, Lernbereitschaft, Zuverlässigkeit, Engagement sowie Freude an Teamarbeit und im Umgang mit Menschen.

​ Das erwartet dich:

• Top Standort in Zürich.

• Freundliches, diverses Team in einem offenen Büro.

• Modernste Technologien, die dir helfen, dich zu verbessern und weiterzukommen.

• Flache Hierarchien mit Zusammenarbeit auf allen Ebenen innerhalb der Bank.

• Und als Goodie: Kostenloses Mittagessen für alle Mitarbeiter, sowie Früchte und Getränke zur freien Verfügung.

Warum Vontobel?
Bei Vontobel arbeiten wir für eine bessere Zukunft unserer Kunden und die Gesellschaft - und natürlich für einen selbst. Bis 2030 wollen wir als eine der führenden und vertrauenswürdigsten globalen Investmenthäusern bekannt sein. Unsere Fähigkeit, uns langfristig auf Themen wie Nachhaltigkeit zu konzentrieren, wird durch die Sicherheit des 100-jährigen Engagements der Familie untermauert. Wir suchen diverse Talente, die in einer sich wandelnden Welt etwas bewegen wollen und die aus den unterschiedlichsten Bereichen kommen.

jobs.description:
For our IT Security division in Zurich, we are seeking an experienced and versatile AI Security Engineer and Architect. If you enjoy working in an agile team, thrive on tackling the daily challenges of a dynamic operating environment, and are excited to contribute to the implementation of complex projects using innovative technologies, this could be your chance!

Are concepts like prompt injection, adversarial inputs, model poisoning, zero trust AI, red teaming, or guardrails part of your daily language? Do you bring a strong understanding of how secure, enterprise grade AI systems are built, tested, and operated at scale? If this sounds familiar, we’d love to hear more about your experience and what inspires you to join our team!

What Would your role be?

• Software Development of IT Security and AI Security solutions.

• AI Security Architecture design and development.

• Technical ownership of security software solutions delivery.

What are we looking for?

• In-depth technical expertise in AI security threats, vulnerabilities, and attack techniques.

• Deep understanding of the OWASP Top 10 and the OWASP Top 10 for Large Language Model (LLM) Applications.

• Proven experience in designing and securing agent-based AI architectures, including tool invocation, memory management, agent communication, and workflow orchestration.

• Experience implementing AI security testing and assurance practices, including red teaming, threat modeling, threat hunting, and risk assessments.

• Strong scripting and automation skills, with experience developing security tooling, scripts, and automated pipelines.

• Solid understanding of cloud security principles and controls, particularly within Microsoft Azure and AI/ML environments.

• Hands-on experience with AI platforms such as Azure AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, or similar managed LLM services is an advantage.

• Agile, adaptable, and passionate about working in a fast-paced, collaborative, and dynamic environment.

• Highly motivated and proactive, with a strong sense of ownership and a commitment to continuous learning and professional development.

• Nice to have: experience securing Generative AI (GenAI) pipelines, including data ingestion, model training, evaluation, and deployment, against adversarial attacks, prompt injection, model manipulation, and data poisoning.
