• Top Zurich location with collaboration spaces and free lunch.

• Friendly, diverse team in an international environment.

• Agile environment in how we think, the way we work and our trust for each other.

• Collaborative spirit with opportunities to learn and thrive.

Unisciti al nostro team di contabilità finanziaria a Zurigo e diventare parte di un'organizzazione di finanza collaborativa e dinamica. In questo ruolo, supporterete la contabilità di Vontobel Asset Management US. Potrai lavorare a stretto contatto con professionisti esperti di finanza e avere l'opportunità di crescere la tua esperienza in un ambiente internazionale. Qual è il tuo ruolo?
• Sostenere le attività di contabilità e di chiusura mensile dell'ente legale degli Stati Uniti, tra cui postazioni di giornale, conciliazioni e contabilità patrimoniale fissa
• Preparare la riconciliazione del bilancio e aiutare a garantire l'accuratezza e la completezza dei record finanziari
• Assicurare la conformità ai controlli interni e mantenere una corretta documentazione nei sistemi di controllo pertinenti
• Collaborare a stretto contatto con colleghi attraverso Contabilità, Controllo, Tesoro, Fiscale e Compliance
• Supporta attivamente il processo di audit esterno, compresa la preparazione della documentazione di audit e le risposte alle richieste di audit
• Supporta progetti di trasformazione finanziaria, tra cui l'implementazione e l'ottimizzazione SAP S/4HANA Cosa stiamo cercando?
• Istruzione superiore in Business Administration, contabilità o finanza, o un apprendistato commerciale con ulteriori qualifiche in contabilità (ad esempio Swiss Federal Diploma in Finanza e Contabilità, Certificato Fiduciario)
• 4-7 anni di esperienza nella contabilità, idealmente in un ambiente americano internazionale e regolamentato
• Forte conoscenza di SAP FI/CO; l'esperienza con i sistemi SAP S/4HANA e P2P (ad esempio Basware, Concur) è un vantaggio
• Buona comprensione dei principi contabili (IFRS, US GAAP) e la loro applicazione
• Alto livello di iniziativa, responsabilità e competenze di lavoro di squadra in un ambiente internazionale
• Strutturato, indipendente e preciso stile di lavoro con una mentalità di qualità forte
• L'affinità per l'intelligenza artificiale (AI) e la volontà di abbracciare strumenti e modi di lavoro abilitati all'intelligenza artificiale.
• Fluente in tedesco e inglese Cosa offriamo?
• Opportunità di crescita all'interno del team di Contabilità Finanziaria ampliato presso il hub di Zurigo
• Un team amichevole e diversificato in un ambiente aperto
• Accesso ai più recenti sistemi IT e strumenti per supportare la crescita professionale
• Ambiente di lavoro Agile all'interno di una cultura della fiducia e della collaborazione
• Opzione per lavorare da casa
• Gerarchia piatta con collaborazione su tutti i livelli
• Posizione Prime Zurigo con ambiente in stile campus e servizi di pranzo gratuiti Stiamo cercando persone di talento, non solo un CV che ticchetta tutte le scatole. Anche se non avete assolutamente tutto quello che abbiamo chiesto, se questo ruolo suona come una buona misura per voi, vi incoraggiamo ad applicare. Perché Vontobel? A Vontobel, stai costruendo un futuro migliore per i nostri clienti e la società, così come per te. Come azienda di proprietà familiare e quotata in pubblico con oltre 2.000 professionisti con sede in 28 sedi a livello globale e con sede a Zurigo, ci impegniamo a pensare e sostenibilità a lungo termine. Il nostro team diversificato valorizza prospettive uniche, e assumere individui determinati a fornire in un mondo dinamico e mutevole. Anche se non soddisfate tutti i criteri, vi incoraggiamo ad applicare se siete entusiasti del ruolo. Vuoi essere Vontobel? Grazie per aver fatto domanda a Vontobel. Noi esamineremo attentamente la vostra applicazione e vi risponderemo in modo tempestivo. A Vontobel, siamo un posto di lavoro pari opportunità. Ci impegniamo a pari opportunità di lavoro indipendentemente da razza, colore, antenati, religione, sesso, origine nazionale, orientamento sessuale, età, cittadinanza, stato civile, disabilità o identità di genere. Apprezziamo le molte voci all'interno dei nostri team e ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente in cui chiunque voglia far parte della nostra cultura delle prestazioni può essere se stesso. Essa si basa sul rispetto reciproco e sulla tolleranza zero per qualsiasi forma di discriminazione. Se avete domande potete contattarci
descriptionByLocale.en:
Are you a motivated professional looking to work in a dynamic international environment and actively shape future finance processes? Join our Financial Accounting team in Zurich and become part of a collaborative and dynamic finance organization. In this role, you will support the accounting of Vontobel Asset Management US. You will work closely with experienced finance professionals and have the opportunity to grow your expertise in an international environment.

What would your role be?

• Support the accounting and monthly closing activities of the US legal entity, including journal postings, reconciliations and fixed asset accounting

• Prepare balance sheet reconciliations and assist in ensuring the accuracy and completeness of financial records

• Ensure compliance with internal controls and maintain proper documentation in the relevant control systems

• Collaborate closely with colleagues across Accounting, Controlling, Treasury, Tax and Compliance

• Actively support the external audit process, including preparation of audit documentation and responses to audit requests

• Support finance transformation projects, including SAP S/4HANA implementation and optimization

What we are looking for?

• Higher education in Business Administration, Accounting or Finance, or a commercial apprenticeship with further qualifications in accounting (e.g. Swiss Federal Diploma in Finance and Accounting, Certified Fiduciary)

• 4-7 years of experience in accounting, ideally in an international and regulated US environment

• Strong knowledge of SAP FI/CO; experience with SAP S/4HANA and P2P systems (e.g. Basware, Concur) is an advantage

• Good understanding of accounting principles (IFRS, US GAAP) and their application

• High level of initiative, accountability, and teamwork skills in an international environment

• Structured, independent, and precise working style with a strong quality mindset

• Affinity for Artificial Intelligence (AI) and a willingness to embrace AI-enabled tools and ways of working.

• Fluent in German and English

What we offer?

• Growth opportunities within the extended Financial Accounting team at the Zurich hub

• Friendly and diverse team in an open-office environment

• Access to the latest IT systems and tools to support your professional growth

• Agile working environment within a culture of trust and collaboration

• Option to work from home

• Flat hierarchy with collaboration across all levels

• Prime Zurich location with campus-style atmosphere and free lunch facilities

We are looking for talented people, not just a CV that ticks all the boxes. Even if you do not have absolutely everything we have asked for, if this role sounds like a good fit for you, we encourage you to apply.
Why Vontobel?
At Vontobel, you are building better futures for our clients and society, as well as for yourself. As a family-owned and publicly listed company with over 2,000 professionals based in 28 locations globally and headquartered in Zurich, we’re committed to long-term thinking and sustainability.
Our diverse team values unique perspectives, and we hire individuals determined to deliver in a dynamic and changing world. Even if you don’t meet all the criteria, we encourage you to apply if you’re enthusiastic about the role.
Do you want to be Vontobel?

Thank you for applying to Vontobel. We will carefully review your application and will respond to you in a timely manner.

At Vontobel, we are an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability or gender identity.
We value the many voices within our teams and are committed to creating an environment where everyone who wants to be part of our performance culture can be themselves. It is based on mutual respect and zero tolerance for any form of discrimination.

If you have any questions you can contact us
descriptionByLocale.de:
Sind Sie ein motivierter Profi, der in einem dynamischen internationalen Umfeld arbeiten und zukünftige Finanzprozesse aktiv mitgestalten möchte? Treten Sie unserem Financial Accounting Team in Zürich bei und werden Sie Teil einer kollaborativen und dynamischen Finanzorganisation. In dieser Funktion unterstützen Sie die Buchhaltung von Vontobel Asset Management US. Sie arbeiten eng mit erfahrenen Finanzexperten zusammen und haben die Möglichkeit, Ihr Fachwissen in einem internationalen Umfeld zu erweitern. Was wäre Ihre Rolle?
• Unterstützung der buchhalterischen und monatlichen Abschlussaktivitäten der US-amerikanischen juristischen Person, einschließlich der Veröffentlichung von Zeitschriften, der Abstimmung und der Buchhaltung von Anlagegütern
• Erstellung von Bilanzabstimmungen und Unterstützung bei der Gewährleistung der Richtigkeit und Vollständigkeit der Finanzunterlagen
• Einhaltung der internen Kontrollen und ordnungsgemäße Dokumentation in den einschlägigen Kontrollsystemen
• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Kollegen aus den Bereichen Accounting, Controlling, Treasury, Tax und Compliance
• Aktive Unterstützung des externen Auditprozesses, einschließlich der Erstellung von Auditdokumentationen und Antworten auf Auditanfragen
• Unterstützung von Finanztransformationsprojekten, einschließlich Implementierung und Optimierung von SAP S/4HANA Wonach suchen wir?
• Hochschulbildung in Betriebswirtschaftslehre, Rechnungswesen oder Finanzen oder eine kaufmännische Ausbildung mit weiteren Qualifikationen im Rechnungswesen (z.B. Eidgenössisches Diplom in Finanzen und Rechnungswesen, Treuhandgesellschaft)
• 4-7 Jahre Erfahrung im Rechnungswesen, idealerweise in einem internationalen und regulierten US-Umfeld
• Große Kenntnisse in SAP FI/CO; Erfahrung mit SAP S/4HANA und P2P Systemen (z.B. Basware, Concur) ist von Vorteil
• Gutes Verständnis der Rechnungslegungsgrundsätze (IFRS, US GAAP) und deren Anwendung
• Hohes Maß an Initiative, Verantwortlichkeit und Teamfähigkeit in einem internationalen Umfeld
• Strukturierter, unabhängiger und präziser Arbeitsstil mit einer starken Qualitätseinstellung
• Affinität für Künstliche Intelligenz (KI) und die Bereitschaft, KI-fähige Werkzeuge und Arbeitsweisen zu nutzen.
• Fließend in Deutsch und Englisch Was bieten wir an?
• Wachstumschancen im erweiterten Financial Accounting Team am Hub Zürich
• Freundliches und vielfältiges Team in einer Open-Office-Umgebung
• Zugang zu den neuesten IT-Systemen und Tools zur Unterstützung Ihres beruflichen Wachstums
• Agiles Arbeitsumfeld in einer Kultur des Vertrauens und der Zusammenarbeit
• Option, von zu Hause aus zu arbeiten
• Flache Hierarchie mit Zusammenarbeit auf allen Ebenen
• Prime Zurich Lage mit Campus-Atmosphäre und kostenlose Mittagessen Wir suchen talentierte Leute, nicht nur einen Lebenslauf, der alle Kästchen ankreuzt. Auch wenn Sie nicht absolut alles haben, wonach wir gefragt haben, wenn diese Rolle nach einer guten Passform für Sie klingt, empfehlen wir Ihnen, sich zu bewerben. Warum Vontobel? Bei Vontobel bauen Sie eine bessere Zukunft für unsere Kunden und die Gesellschaft sowie für sich selbst. Als familiengeführtes und börsennotiertes Unternehmen mit über 2.000 Fachleuten an 28 Standorten weltweit mit Hauptsitz in Zürich setzen wir auf langfristiges Denken und Nachhaltigkeit. Unser vielfältiges Team schätzt einzigartige Perspektiven und wir stellen Einzelpersonen ein, die entschlossen sind, in einer dynamischen und sich verändernden Welt zu liefern. Auch wenn Sie nicht alle Kriterien erfüllen, empfehlen wir Ihnen, sich zu bewerben, wenn Sie von der Rolle begeistert sind. Wollen Sie Vontobel sein? Vielen Dank, dass Sie sich bei Vontobel bewerben. Wir werden Ihre Bewerbung sorgfältig prüfen und Ihnen rechtzeitig antworten. Bei Vontobel sind wir ein Chancengleichheitsarbeitsplatz. Wir setzen uns für gleiche Beschäftigungsmöglichkeiten ein, unabhängig von Rasse, Hautfarbe, Abstammung, Religion, Geschlecht, nationaler Herkunft, sexueller Orientierung, Alter, Staatsangehörigkeit, Familienstand, Behinderung oder Geschlechtsidentität. Wir schätzen die vielen Stimmen in unseren Teams und setzen uns dafür ein, ein Umfeld zu schaffen, in dem jeder, der Teil unserer Leistungskultur sein möchte, er selbst sein kann. Sie basiert auf gegenseitigem Respekt und Null-Toleranz für jede Form von Diskriminierung. Wenn Sie Fragen haben, können Sie uns kontaktieren

• Niveau élevé d'initiative, de responsabilisation et de travail d'équipe dans un environnement international

• Possibilités de croissance au sein de l'équipe de comptabilité financière élargie du hub de Zurich
• Équipe amicale et diversifiée dans un environnement ouvert
• Accès aux derniers systèmes et outils informatiques pour soutenir votre croissance professionnelle
• Un environnement de travail agile dans une culture de confiance et de collaboration
• Option de travail à domicile
• Hiérarchie plate avec collaboration à tous les niveaux
• Emplacement Prime Zurich avec une ambiance de style campus et un déjeuner gratuit Nous cherchons des gens talentueux, pas seulement un CV qui coche toutes les boîtes. En tant qu'entreprise familiale et cotée en bourse avec plus de 2 000 professionnels basés sur 28 sites à l'échelle mondiale et ayant son siège à Zurich, nous sommes engagés dans la pensée et la durabilité à long terme. Notre équipe diversifiée valorise des perspectives uniques, et nous embauchons des individus déterminés à livrer dans un monde dynamique et changeant. Même si vous ne répondez pas à tous les critères, nous vous encourageons à postuler si vous êtes enthousiaste au sujet du rôle. Tu veux être Vontobel ? Merci d'avoir postulé à Vontobel. Nous examinerons attentivement votre demande et vous répondrons en temps opportun. À Vontobel, nous sommes un lieu de travail à égalité des chances. Nous sommes attachés à l'égalité des chances en matière d'emploi, indépendamment de la race, de la couleur, de l'ascendance, de la religion, du sexe, de l'origine nationale, de l'orientation sexuelle, de l'âge, de la citoyenneté, de l'état matrimonial, du handicap ou de l'identité de genre. Nous apprécions les nombreuses voix au sein de nos équipes et nous nous engageons à créer un environnement où tous ceux qui veulent faire partie de notre culture de la performance peuvent être eux-mêmes. jobs.title: Senior Avaloq & Securities Accounting Specialist
jobs.description:
Do you have deep expertise in Avaloq Accounting and securities accounting systems? Are you passionate about ensuring high-quality financial reporting while continuously improving accounting processes and systems? Join our Finance Hub Zurich and become a key member of our Securities Accounting & Reporting team. In this role, you will act as the subject matter expert for Avaloq Accounting and our securities accounting sub-ledger (ePOCA), supporting both operational excellence and ongoing finance transformation initiatives.

What would your role be?

• Act as the subject matter expert for Avaloq Accounting and the Securities Accounting sub-ledger (ePOCA)

• End-to-end responsibility for financial instruments accounting processes within a sub-ledger system from importing transactions and exporting booking items

• Maintain and further develop the accounting setup in Avaloq and ePOCA to reflect new business requirements and regulatory changes

• Drive process improvements, automation initiatives and finance transformation projects in the area of securities accounting sub-ledger

• Support the current accounting team, in ensuring accurate booking, valuation, and reconciliation of financial instruments

• Deliver accounting data and reporting for Group Finance, local statutory reporting, Tax and other internal stakeholders

• Ensuring compliance with relevant international and local accounting standards (IFRS, FINMA) and internal control requirements

What are we looking for?

• Broad experience in corresponding accounting Sub-ledger systems in a banking environment (SAP TRM, ePOCA, Avaloq)

• Strong background in securities accounting and investment operations like corporate actions, income events and position movements of the own financial instruments from the bank and other group entities

• Experience in reporting from data warehouses and/or other data sources is desirable

• Knowledge of tax accounting relating to financial instruments (e.g. withholding tax, Section 871(m)) is an advantage)

• Experience working with SAP S/4HANA and reporting solutions or data warehouses is desirable

• Proven project and transformation experience, ideally involving SAP TRM or other sub-ledger implementations

• Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and a proactive hands-on mindset

• Affinity for Artificial Intelligence (AI) and a willingness to embrace AI-enabled tools and ways of working.

What do we offer?

• Growth opportunities within the expanded Finance Hub Zurich

• Friendly and diverse team in an open-plan office environment

• State-of-the-art IT systems and tools to support your development and progression

• Agile working environment built on trust and collaboration

• Opportunity for remote working / home office

• Flat hierarchy with collaboration across all levels of the organization

• Prime Zurich location with a campus-like atmosphere and complimentary lunch

We are looking for talented people, not just a CV that ticks all the boxes. Even if you do not have absolutely everything we have asked for, if this role sounds like a good fit for you, we encourage you to apply.
Why Vontobel?
At Vontobel, you are building better futures for our clients and society, as well as for yourself. As a family-owned and publicly listed company with over 2,000 professionals based in 28 locations globally and headquartered in Zurich, we’re committed to long-term thinking and sustainability.
Our diverse team values unique perspectives, and we hire individuals determined to deliver in a dynamic and changing world. Even if you don’t meet all the criteria, we encourage you to apply if you’re enthusiastic about the role.
Do you want to be Vontobel?

Thank you for applying to Vontobel. We will carefully review your application and will respond to you in a timely manner.

At Vontobel, we are an equal opportunity workplace.
